claim: A slide (614/616) moves its walls and sprites by the difference between its two markers (DragPoint to x+vc-a4), so where the marker pair stands is free: 52 of 248 tutorial movers park the pair far from the poses. A pose can never be read from the markers' coordinates.
evidence: Count of parked pairs over the tutorial movers by bloodmap.curriculum, 2026-09-01.
use: Place the two markers wherever is convenient; read the travel as marker1 minus marker0.
